verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Sentry dashboards with widgets for errors, model cost, and token usage. Nothing in it documents configurable alert rules on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops, or notification delivery to Slack, PagerDuty, or email. Dashboards that only visualize these metrics are an adjacent feature, not alerting. The single community remark about 'unhandled-exception alerts' is indirect and names no thresholds or channels, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email
